li.label: saw a necromorph
li.description: That thing was a person once. I cannot stop looking at it.

li.label: necromorphs in sight
li.description: There is more than one. They keep coming.

li.label: surrounded by necromorphs
li.description: I can hear them everywhere. Every shape is one of them.

li.label: overrun by necromorphs
li.description: There are too many. This is how it ends.
